history.summary: New freehold (2024 TOP) compact 4BR at Tedge (D14) for $2.2M / $1777 PSF, sitting slightly below the $1811 new-launch-skewed median. With has_new_launch_bias true and a developer-pricing-inflated 2.8%/yr appreciation, this is a recently-launched unit where most of the value is already in the price; efficient 4BR at a sub-$2.5M freehold entry keeps it Neutral.
history.rating_rationale: 1238 sqft for a 4BR is very efficient (compact, likely a 'shoebox 4BR' layout) but freehold and in the deep-pool $2.2M band. The 2.8%/yr rate is flagged as new-launch-biased (developer inflation already baked into the $1811 median), so forward upside is limited until the project seasons. Only 25 txn and a brand-new resale market mean no proven resale track record — balanced, not a buy yet.
